steps: Verify the identity of Ann by requesting valid government-issued identification.
Confirm with Ann that she wishes to update her address to 'prince street, 4'.
Retrieve Ann’s existing account details from the banking system using her account number or customer ID.
Check for any pending transactions or alerts that may be affected by the address change.
Enter the new address 'prince street, 4' into the customer profile in the banking system.
Cross-verify the new address for completeness and formatting compliance (e.g., no special characters, proper casing).
Send a confirmation email or SMS to Ann’s registered contact information notifying her of the update.
Request Ann to sign a digital or physical address change form if required by compliance policy.
Update any linked services (e.g., statement delivery, mailing preferences) to reflect the new address.
Log the change in the system audit trail with timestamp, operator ID, and reason for update.
